entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. You're speaking with Sarah at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to start a return for a ProFit Jersey I bought a little while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-01. The name is Alex Chen.

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the ProFit Jersey, delivered about 50 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the material or more of a preference matter?

It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered the medium, but it's the wrong size for me. I finally wore it on a longer ride and it's just way too tight in the shoulders. I was hoping to exchange it, or just return it if that's easier.
I understand. A good fit is essential for comfort. Let me just check the policy for that jersey.

Okay, good news. I've confirmed that the ProFit jersey falls under our standard 90-day return policy. Since you received it 50 days ago, you're well within that window. I can approve this return for a full refund for you right now.

That's great news, thank you. I do appreciate that. Now, since I will be ordering the correct size and I have to go through the hassle of repackaging this one, is there any chance you could provide a small 10% discount code for my next purchase?

That's a fair question, Alex. I can see why you'd ask. Unfortunately, our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on standard returns for fit or preference. We do provide a prepaid shipping label to make the process free of charge for you. Once we receive the original jersey, the full refund will be processed back to your card.
Alright, I understand. Had to try. The full refund and free shipping label work for me. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. I've just sent that return label to the email on your account. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
